title: Task Graph
description: Output of plan-writer for one story. Consumed by feature-orchestrator (step 11) to sequence and parallelize implementer runs, and by story-converter in plan mode to create/sync tracked tickets. Written by feature-orchestrator to <stories_dir>/<story-id>-<slug>/plan.json, where stories_dir comes from config/orchestration.yaml - not a fixed path.

id.description: Stable identifier for this task. This is the key story-converter matches tickets against on every sync — don't regenerate it across amendments.

depends_on.description: Task ids that must reach status 'validated' before this task can start.

parallel_group.description: Tasks sharing a group id may run as concurrent implementer subagent sessions. Null means this task always runs alone. Two tasks may only share a group if their files_touched sets are fully disjoint.

files_touched.description: Every file this task creates or modifies. implementer is not authorized to touch anything outside this list — see the Scope amendment loop in feature-orchestrator for the documented exception path.
